title: 💥9 DANCES in 12 MINUTES💥Learn in this Ballroom Dance Course more then in your Entire Life! BASICS

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down fundamental ballroom steps using clear verbal instructions and physical demonstrations with a partner. He emphasizes weight changes and styling variations for each basic element.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to basic elements of ballroom dancing

common_mistakes: Not changing body weight on the together steps

steps_taught.name: Box Step
steps_taught.description: Forward, side, together, back, side, together

steps_taught.name: Triple Step
steps_taught.description: Three small steps with weight change at the end

steps_taught.name: Rock Step
steps_taught.description: Rocking weight back and forth between feet

what_works: Demonstrating with a partner helps visualize social dance positioning
Breaking dances down into three core foundational steps
what_hinders: Camera angles shift between front and back views which can require adjustment

quotes.text: Today we'd like to teach you the most basic elements of ballroom dancing.
In a good dancing it's not what you do, it's how you do it.
Triple step by itself is already a dance.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates box step holding partner's hand, stepping forward with left foot.
Teacher demonstrates waltz frame hand placement on partner's shoulder blade.

extraction.distinctive_method: Teaching three universal foundational steps (box step, triple step, rock step) as the building blocks for multiple different ballroom and social dances.
